composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an adobe terrace with woven shade screens. The screen casts broad woven shadows across the lower terrace wall, while its top stops below the open sky. Add a short stair and one recessed bench built into the adobe. Show fiber texture and rounded plaster edges with care. Avoid decorative objects; the light pattern and material junctions provide richness. Use detailed architectural illustration. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
